message.content: {"rules":["An Allocator implementation whose allocated memory is stored within the allocator, such as MyAlloc([u8; N]), must not be moved without updating pointers to that memory.","An Allocator implementation must handle zero-sized allocations even if its underlying allocator does not support them or returns a null pointer for them.","A block is currently allocated by an Allocator only if its starting address was previously returned by that allocator's allocate, grow, or shrink method and the block has not subsequently been deallocated.","For determining whether a block is currently allocated, deallocate deallocates the block, and grow or shrink deallocates the input block when it returns Ok; grow or shrink returning Err does not deallocate the input block.","For a layout to fit a memory block, the block must be currently allocated with alignment equal to layout.align().","For a layout to fit a memory block, layout.size() must be in the inclusive range from the size of the layout used to allocate the block to the actual size returned by allocate, grow, or shrink.","Memory blocks currently allocated by an Allocator must point to valid memory and remain valid until either the block is deallocated or the allocator is dropped.","Copying an Allocator must not invalidate memory blocks returned from it.","Cloning an Allocator must not invalidate memory blocks returned from it.","Moving an Allocator must not invalidate memory blocks returned from it.","A copied Allocator must behave like the original allocator.","A cloned Allocator must behave like the original allocator.","A currently allocated memory block may be passed to any method of its allocator that accepts such an argument.","For Allocator::grow, ptr must denote a block currently allocated via that allocator.","For Allocator::grow, old_layout must fit the block denoted by ptr.","For Allocator::grow, new_layout.size() must be greater than or equal to old_layout.size().","For Allocator::grow, new_layout need not fit the existing block.","For Allocator::grow, new_layout.align() need not equal old_layout.align().","After Allocator::grow returns Ok, any access through the old ptr is undefined behavior, even if the allocation grew in place; only the newly returned pointer is valid for accessing that memory.","For Allocator::shrink, ptr must denote a block currently allocated via that allocator.","For Allocator::shrink, old_layout must fit the block denoted by ptr.","For Allocator::shrink, new_layout.size() must be less than or equal to old_layout.size().","For Allocator::shrink, new_layout need not fit the existing block.","For Allocator::shrink, new_layout.align() need not equal old_layout.align().","After Allocator::shrink returns Ok, any access through the old ptr is undefined behavior, even if the allocation shrank in place; only the newly returned pointer is valid for accessing that memory.","An Allocator implementation may use an underlying native allocation library that aborts on memory exhaustion; returning Err on memory exhaustion in grow or shrink is not required."]}
